dataDisclosure: The bridge sends the text prompt or reference image you submit to the public three.ws Forge API over HTTPS and downloads the finished .glb. It sends a random per-install client handle for rate limiting. It reads no project files other than the image you choose to submit, and sends no telemetry.
releaseNotes: 0.1.0: first public release. Browse the catalog, generate a mesh from a text prompt or reference photos, poll the job, and import the result with the engine's own glTF importer, with collider, material and scale import settings.
tagline: Text or photo to a textured 3D model, imported into your scene.
description: Generate a textured 3D model from a text prompt or reference photos with the free three.ws Forge pipeline and import it straight into the scene. The addon adds a three.ws Forge dock to the editor and a ThreeWsClient node for scripts. Downloads are imported with Godot's native GLTFDocument importer, so no third-party importer is needed. Import settings cover convex collision shapes, material import and uniform scale. A runnable example scene and a headless smoke test are included. Every call goes to the live public three.ws API.

submission.upload: Asset Library > Submit Asset. Download provider: Custom. Download URL: the release asset URL of the packaged zip. Godot installs the zip contents into the project, so the archive holds addons/three_ws_bridge plus LICENSE and README.md.
submission.media: Icon: a 128px or larger PNG URL (rendered at dist/engine-stores/godot/artwork). Add 2 or more screenshot URLs of the dock.
